title: Edge deployment mutation acknowledgement v1
description: Conditional proxy DELETE or API-spec PUT result. Consumers require HTTP 200, the expected deployment-v1 profile/target, durable=committed, live=applied and recovery_cleanup_authorized=true before automatic journal removal or dependent cleanup. Missing fields, refusal, cancellation and uncertain transport never authorize replay. Local application does not attest every remote DP.

x-contract.name: admin-deployment-mutation-acknowledgement
x-contract.edge_availability: Released since Ferrum Edge v0.9.12; unchanged shape re-read at v0.9.13 source 9b83115de7ec23ab51ec4feae6bed65e596db425, where a 507 NamespaceSnapshotTooLarge body reports durable not_started (snapshot read or pre-transaction check) or not_committed (rolled-back mutation transaction).

provenance.note: Transcribed required members, optional profile/id/error and open object shape. The additional implication for cleanup authorization copies finish: true is emitted only after confirmed commit and applicable local application, final audit admission and lease release. HTTP status and profile/target matching remain consumer runtime checks.

recovery_cleanup_authorized.description: True only after confirmed commit, applicable local live proof, final audit admission and namespace lease release. CP/unserved durable-only results are false even with HTTP 200.
